usage: ‘公斤’ is used to measure weight and always follows a numerical value.
When using ‘公斤’, the number comes before the word, e.g., ‘兩公斤’ (two kilograms).
‘公斤’ can be used in both formal and informal contexts when talking about weight.
You can use ‘公斤’ to specify weight in cooking, shipping, or shopping.
‘公斤’ is often used with classifiers like ‘兩’ (two) or ‘三’ (three) in everyday speech.
